@[expose] public section

open CategoryTheory MorphismProperty Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {X Y Z S : Scheme} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S)

/-- We say that morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` is geometrically irreducible if for all `Spec K ⟶ Y` with `K`
a field, `X ×[Y] Spec K` is irreducible. -/
@[mk_iff]
class GeometricallyIrreducible (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop where
  geometrically_irreducibleSpace : geometrically (IrreducibleSpace ·) f

lemma GeometricallyIrreducible.eq_geometrically :
    @GeometricallyIrreducible = geometrically (IrreducibleSpace ·) := by
  ext; exact geometricallyIrreducible_iff _

instance : IsStableUnderBaseChange @GeometricallyIrreducible :=
  GeometricallyIrreducible.eq_geometrically ▸ inferInstance

instance [GeometricallyIrreducible g] : GeometricallyIrreducible (pullback.fst f g) :=
  MorphismProperty.pullback_fst f g inferInstance

instance [GeometricallyIrreducible f] : GeometricallyIrreducible (pullback.snd f g) :=
  MorphismProperty.pullback_snd f g inferInstance

instance (V : S.Opens) [GeometricallyIrreducible f] : GeometricallyIrreducible (f ∣_ V) :=
  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict ..).flip ‹_›

instance (s : S) [GeometricallyIrreducible f] :
    GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s) :=
  MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _ inferInstance

instance (s : S) [GeometricallyIrreducible f] : IrreducibleSpace (f.fiber s) :=
  GeometricallyIrreducible.geometrically_irreducibleSpace _ _ _ (.of_hasPullback _ _)

instance (priority := low) [GeometricallyIrreducible f] : Surjective f :=
  ⟨fun x ↦ ⟨_, (f.range_fiberι x).le ⟨Nonempty.some inferInstance, rfl⟩⟩⟩

lemma Scheme.Hom.isIrreducible_preimage
    [GeometricallyIrreducible f] (hf : IsOpenMap f)
    {s : Set S} (hs : IsIrreducible s) : IsIrreducible (f ⁻¹' s) := by
  wlog H : ∃ x, s = {x} generalizing s
  · refine hs.preimage_of_isPreirreducible_fiber _ hf

    rw [Set.range_eq_univ.mpr f.surjective, Set.inter_univ]
    exact hs.nonempty
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := H
  rw [← f.range_fiberι, ← Set.image_univ]

Review complete. Verdicts per item, with the evidence I actually ran.

## 1. Sorry-freeness of CodimOneExtension.lean and RigidityLemma.lean — CONFIRMED

Term-level grep (`(^|[^A-Za-z_.])sorry([^A-Za-z_]|$)`) returns 11 hits in `CodimOneExtension.lean` and 3 in `RigidityLemma.lean`, and **every one is inside a docstring or comment** — I printed all of them; e.g. `CodimOneExtension.lean:53` "**This file is `sorry`-free.**", `RigidityLemma.lean:764` "whole Rigidity-Lemma chain is `sorry`-free". No bare `sorry` on its own line, no `sorry`-terminated tactic block.

The stronger check: the full `lake build` emits `declaration uses 'sorry'` warnings for 28 declarations across the project, and **not one of them is in `Albanese/CodimOneExtension.lean`, `RigidityLemma.lean`, or any `Milne33*.lean`, `GrpObjFoldSum.lean`, `DenseOpenDescent.lean`, `Thm32RationalMapExtension.lean`**. Confirmed independently by `#print axioms` on `indeterminacy_codimGe2_of_smooth_of_complete`, `existsUnique_hom_of_indeterminacyLocus_eq_empty`, `rigidity_eqOn_dense_open` — all `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.

## 2. Axiom-cleanliness of the two headline theorems — CONFIRMED as stated, but the claim needs a caveat the session did not state

`#print axioms` via `lake env lean` on a probe file:

```
indeterminacy_pure_codim_one_into_grpScheme       [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
indeterminacy_pure_codim_one_into_grpScheme_core  [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
extend_to_av                                      [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
exists_unique_hom_restrict_eq_of_dense_open       [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
hom_toRationalMap_eq_partialMap_iff               [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
isSeparated_left_of_isProper                      [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
powSum_perm / comp_powSum / preHom                [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
rigidity_lemma / rigidity_core / hom_additive_decomp_of_rigidity /
  av_regularMap_isHom_of_zero                     [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
```

On the instance-leak subtlety I checked specifically. `extend_to_av`'s binders are `[Smooth] [GeometricallyIrreducible] [IsSeparated] [LocallyOfFiniteType] [IsIntegral] [IsReduced] [GrpObj A] [IsProper A.hom]` — all mathlib classes. **None is discharged in this project by a sorried instance.** The only sorry-bodied instance in AJC is `pullback_preservesFiniteLimits` (`Cohomology/CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional.lean:206`), unrelated to this binder set; the other project sorries are all `theorem`/`def`-bodied, and the previously-leaking `instHasPicScheme` was *deleted* as an instance by the concurrent étale rewire.

The honest caveat, which I measured: the AV package is *not* currently inhabitable axiom-cleanly at the object the Albanese leg actually wants. A synthesis-site probe instantiating `extend_to_av` at `A := Jacobian C` reports

```
'probe_extend_at_jacobian' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
```

because `nonempty_jacobianWitness` is `sorryAx`-tainted (via `fgaPicardRepresentability`). This is not a defect in the session's proof — the taint is upstream, in another lane's territory — and the session did say `albanese_universal_property` is not sorry-free. But "`extend_to_av` is unconditional" reads stronger than the situation warrants: it is unconditional *as a theorem about any abelian variety*, and there is at present no axiom-clean witness that an abelian variety exists in this development. I could not construct one (the unit object and `𝔸(0)` both fail `GeometricallyIrreducible` synthesis). That is worth saying out loud; the session did not.

## 3. Is the ported Milne 3.3 honest? — CONFIRMED, no smuggling

(a) **Statement matches the blueprint.** Blueprint `lem:milne_codim1_indeterminacy` (`blueprint/src/chapters/Albanese_CodimOneExtension.tex:1658`) pins exactly `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.indeterminacy_pure_codim_one_into_grpScheme`, and the source quote is Milne's Lemma 3.3 verbatim. The Lean conclusion is the same disjunction the pre-session `CodimOneExtension.lean` sorry-carrier had, character for character (I diffed the deleted statement in `hgit show 8a5dc2a66` against the new one): `indeterminacyLocus f = ∅ ∨ ∀ x ∈ indeterminacyLocus f, ∃ z ∈ indeterminacyLocus f, Order.coheight z = 1 ∧ x ∈ closure {z}`. The Rebuild original stated `Milne33Indeterminacy f`, whose definition (`Rebuild/.../CodimOneIndeterminacy.lean:170-174`) unfolds to precisely that. **The port inlined the abbreviation; it did not weaken it.**

One real difference, and it is a *strengthening* of the binder set in the harmless direction: the port dropped `[Smooth G.hom]` and `[GeometricallyIrreducible G.hom]`/`[IsIntegral G.left]` from where the old sorry-carrier had them and the wrapper re-adds them. The core needs strictly less than the wrapper. I verified this by building a variant with the three target-side hypotheses removed — it still elaborates axiom-clean. So the wrapper is *over*-hypothesised relative to what is proved, never under.

(b) **The strong branch survived.** `z ∈ indeterminacyLocus f` is present as the binder of the inner `∃`, and the docstring at `Milne33.lean:226-230` reproduces the blueprint's own warning about why it is essential. The consumer `av_indeterminacyLocus_eq_empty` (`Thm32RationalMapExtension.lean:199-202`) actually *uses* that conjunct: it feeds `hzZ` into `indeterminacy_codimGe2_of_smooth_of_complete` to derive the contradiction. Without it the proof would not close.

(c) **No new axiom, no `native_decide`, no `@[implemented_by]`, no `unsafe`/`partial`.** Grepped all nine ported files plus `RigidityLemma.lean`: the only `axiom`/`partial` hits are the words appearing in prose. `set_option`s are `autoImplicit false`, `maxSynthPendingDepth 3`, and one `linter.overlappingInstances false` — none soundness-relevant.

(d) **The wrapper genuinely proves from the core.** `Milne33.lean:257-266`: two `haveI`s (`IrreducibleSpace ↥X.left` by `inferInstance` from `IsIntegral`; `G.left.IsSeparated` from `IsSeparated G.hom` composed with the affine `Spec k̄ ⟶ ⊤_ Scheme`) then `exact ..._core f hover`. No extra hypothesis, no `sorry`, and both wrapper and core measure axiom-clean separately.

Provenance is as described: `diff` against the Rebuild originals shows only import retargeting (`Algebra.AB*` → `Albanese/AuslanderBuchsbaum`, `CodimOne{DVRStalk,SmoothReduced}` → `CodimOneExtension`) and a copyright-header rewrite from "Christian Merten" to "The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors". Proof bodies are byte-identical.

## 4. `powSum_perm` — CONFIRMED non-vacuous

I probed the definitional content rather than trusting the docstring:

- `powSum 2 φ = lift (π₀ ≫ φ) (π₁ ≫ φ) ≫ μ[A]` closes by `rfl` after `Fin.prod_univ_two`. So the multiplication really is the cartesian-monoidal group law, not a placeholder.
- `powSum 1 φ = π₀ ≫ φ`. Not degenerate.
- `powSum 0 φ = toUnit _ ≫ η[A]` — the empty product is the unit, as it must be. The theorem is trivially true at `n = 0` but that is one degenerate index, not the general statement.
- `permAut C σ ≫ permAut C σ.symm = 𝟙` proves by `permAut_π` + `Equiv.apply_symm_apply`: it is a genuine automorphism realising the `S_n` action, `σ`-arbitrary.
- The statement quantifies over an arbitrary `σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)` and arbitrary `n`.
- **Commutativity is load-bearing.** Restating `powSum` with only `[MonObj A]` (dropping `IsCommMonObj`) fails to elaborate: `failed to synthesize CommMonoid ((∏ᶜ fun x => C) ⟶ A)`. The `∏` notation cannot even be written without it.

Minor overstatement here: the commit says an abelian variety "is a commutative group object there," but the project has **no** `IsCommMonObj` instance for its AV package. My probe instantiating `powSum g φ` at the project's AV binder set fails on `failed to synthesize IsCommMonObj A`. So `powSum` is not yet applicable to the actual Albanese target without someone supplying AV commutativity (Milne I.1's corollary of rigidity, which `RigidityLemma.lean` has the ingredients for but does not state). The lemma is correct and general; the claim that it is ready as "the input that the universal property of `Sym^g C` consumes" skips that missing instance.

## 5. `exists_unique_hom_restrict_eq_of_dense_open` — CONFIRMED, `hover` is satisfiable

Axiom-clean (above). On satisfiability I did not reason, I proved it: for any `g : X ⟶ A` over `k̄` with `V = ⊤` and `h = ⊤.ι ≫ g`, the `hover` hypothesis discharges (via `compHom_toRationalMap` + `PartialMap.equiv_iff_of_isSeparated_of_le`) and the lemma applies, axiom-clean. So `hover` is a genuine over-`k̄` compatibility condition, not a disguised falsehood.

`hom_toRationalMap_eq_partialMap_iff` is a real `iff` in both directions — it is proved by `rw` through `PartialMap.toRationalMap_eq_iff` and `PartialMap.equiv_iff_of_isSeparated_of_le`, both of which are themselves iffs, then `simp`. Both directions are consumed in the descent proof (`.mp` for existence, `.mpr` for uniqueness), so neither is dead.

Pre-session state is `306349cc5` (parent of `8a5dc2a66`). Its `AlbaneseUP.lean` has 6 bare `sorry`s at lines 335/382/416/453/496/533; HEAD has 6 at 361/405/450/489/541/577 (371/415/460/499/551/587 in the working tree, after another lane's edit). `hgit show --name-only` for the four commits touches exactly: `AlgebraicJacobian.lean` (import lines only — I verified the diff is 11 `+import` lines and nothing else), `Albanese/{CodimOneExtension, Milne33, Milne33×8, Thm32RationalMapExtension, GrpObjFoldSum, DenseOpenDescent, AlbaneseUP}.lean`, `blueprint/src/chapters/Albanese_CodimOneExtension.tex`, `hgraph/nodes/ca0776c343e5/comment-1.md`. **No `Picard/`, no `Cohomology/`, no `Jacobian.lean`, nothing in Rebuild or SubProjects.**

theorem av_regularMap_isHom_of_zero
    [IsAlgClosed kbar]
    {A B : Over (Spec (.of kbar))}
    [GrpObj A] [IsProper A.hom] [Smooth A.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible (A ⊗ A).hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ⊗ A).hom]
    [IsReduced (A ⊗ A).left]
    [GrpObj B] [IsProper B.hom]
    (α : A ⟶ B) (hα : η[A] ≫ α = η[B]) :
    IsMonHom α := by
  -- `η[A]` is the identity of the hom-group `Hom(𝟙_, A)`, so `η[A] · η[A] = η[A]`.
  have h1 : (η[A] : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of kbar))) ⟶ A) = 1 := by
    rw [Hom.one_def, toUnit_unique (toUnit _) (𝟙 _), Category.id_comp]
  have hbase : lift η[A] η[A] ≫ μ[A] = η[A] := by
    rw [← Hom.mul_def, h1, _root_.mul_one]
  -- Corollary 1.5 applied to `h := μ[A] ≫ α` with `V = W = A`, based at `η[A]`.
  have key := hom_additive_decomp_of_rigidity (V := A) (W := A) (A := B)
    η[A] η[A] (μ[A] ≫ α) (by rw [← Category.assoc, hbase, hα])
  -- Both axis-restrictions of `μ[A] ≫ α` reduce to `α` (monoid unit laws).
  rw [show lift (𝟙 A) (toUnit A ≫ η[A]) ≫ μ[A] ≫ α = α by
        rw [← Category.assoc, lift_comp_one_right, Category.id_comp],
      show lift (toUnit A ≫ η[A]) (𝟙 A) ≫ μ[A] ≫ α = α by
        rw [← Category.assoc, lift_comp_one_left, Category.id_comp]] at key
  -- `key : μ[A] ≫ α = (fst A A ≫ α) · (snd A A ≫ α)`; package as `IsMonHom`.
  exact { one_hom := hα, mul_hom := by rw [key, Hom.mul_def, lift_fst_comp_snd_comp] }
